billingAccounts.title: Billing accounts
billingAccounts.description: A billing account holds prepaid credit and pays for the organizations that are linked to it.
billingAccounts.empty.title: No billing accounts yet
billingAccounts.empty.description: Create one to pay for Delino services, or accept an invitation from a billing account owner.
createAccount.title: Create a billing account
createAccount.description: You become its owner. To use it, start the $10/month subscription.
createAccount.name: Name
invitation.missing.title: Invitation
invitation.missing.description: This page needs the link from an invitation email. Ask an owner or admin of the billing account to invite you again.
invitation.join.title: Join the billing account
invitation.join.description: You join as the signed-in user. The invitation works only once and only for the invited email address.
invitation.mayHaveJoined: You may have joined the billing account.
invitation.signIn.title: You are invited to a billing account
invitation.signIn.description: Sign in with the email address that received the invitation to accept it.
balance.title: Balance
balance.negative: The balance is negative. The next credit pays off the debt first.
topUp.title: Top up credit
topUp.description: Charge the subscription's payment method once. Enter {min} to {max}; tax is added on top. The credit appears when Paddle confirms the payment.
topUp.accepted: Paddle accepted the {amount} top-up. The credit appears when the payment is confirmed.
subscription.title: Subscription
subscription.price: {price} per month. Each payment adds {price} of credit. Services need an active subscription.
subscription.pending: Waiting for Paddle to confirm the first payment. This page updates when the payment is confirmed. If you closed the checkout before paying, continue the checkout.
subscription.pastDue: A renewal payment failed, and Paddle retries it. Check the payment method in the email from Paddle.
subscription.checkoutNotConfigured: Checkout is not configured for this build.
subscription.cancelDialog.title: Cancel the subscription?
subscription.cancelDialog.descriptionWit: It stays active until {date}. After that, linked organizations cannot use paid features. You can resume it before then.
subscription.cancelDialog.description: It stays active until the end of the paid period. After that, linked organizations cannot use paid features.
credit.title: Credit
credit.description: Credit expires 12 months after purchase. Usage takes the credit that expires first.
usage.title: Usage
usage.caption: Usage by service, organization and meter
ledger.title: Ledger
ledger.description: Every change of the balance, newest first.
members.title: Members
members.removeDialog.title: Remove {name}?
members.removeDialog.description: They lose access to this billing account. Linked organizations stay linked.
members.transferDialog.title: Make {name} the owner?
members.transferDialog.description: There is only one owner. You become an admin and can no longer delete the billing account or transfer ownership.
members.leaveDialog.title: Leave this billing account?
members.leaveDialog.description: You lose access to its balance, usage and settings. An owner or admin can invite you again.
invitations.title: Invitations
invitations.dialog.description: We email a link that works once for 7 days. The person accepts it after signing in with this email address.
invitations.dialog.roleViewer: Viewer: reads balance, usage and settings
organizations.title: Linked organizations
organizations.description: This billing account pays for these organizations. Link or unlink an organization in its service, for example in the OwnSand console.
invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.description: Paddle is the merchant of record and issues the invoices. Amounts exclude tax.
settings.readOnly: Only owners and admins can change these settings.
settings.name.title: Name
settings.name.label: Billing account name
autoTopUp.title: Automatic top-up
autoTopUp.description: Buy credit automatically when a usage charge makes the balance fall below the threshold. The monthly cap limits automatic top-ups in one UTC calendar month. Automatic top-ups in progress count toward the cap. After 2 failed top-ups in a row, automatic top-up turns off.
autoTopUp.disabledHint: Enter amounts of {zero} or more in whole cents. Blank fields save as {zero}. Saved values are available when you turn automatic top-up on.
autoTopUp.amountHint: {min} to {max}. Tax is added on top.
autoTopUp.monthlyCapHint: Required. At least the top-up amount.
alert.title: Low-balance alert
alert.description: While automatic top-up is off, owners and admins get an email when the balance falls below this amount.
deleteAccount.title: Delete billing account
deleteAccount.description: You can delete the billing account only when its balance is {zero} or more and no organization is linked. Deletion cancels the subscription at once, and the remaining credit is not refunded.
deleteAccount.dialog.title: Delete {name}?
deleteAccount.dialog.description: The subscription ends now, the remaining credit is lost and every member loses access. This cannot be undone.
